reviewerRubric.first-use: status reports unavailable until explicit refresh publishes an in-memory generation
reviewerRubric.search-gate: search requires current policy and rejects unavailable, stale, or unknown policy state
reviewerRubric.freshness: eligible source and policy are re-inspected against the generation before results are returned
reviewerRubric.continuation: cursors are generation-and-term bound, single-use after successful completion, expire after five minutes, and are capped at 128 live entries
reviewerRubric.trust: results are local-source-unsigned navigation evidence and do not grant authority or execute instructions
